_comment: Tags excluded from default PR Maestro batches. Zephyr tier labels: detox/maestro/README.md.
_MM-T5611: Skip iOS: CI run 30000635898 — external browser launch did not return to the Home tab.
_MM-T3260: Skip Android: CI run 30331493720 (PR #9893, SHA 9f1496e) — help_url.yml failed with 'Unable to launch app com.mattermost.rnbeta' after ~136s (batch-7); already excluded on iOS for browser hand-off flakes. Chrome Custom Tab hand-off leaves the driver unable to relaunch the app on API 35.
_MM-T1325: Skip iOS: CI run 30334294934 (PR #9893, SHA 347842c) — clock_display.yml failed after login retries with 'Assertion is false: id: tab_bar.home.tab is visible' (~215s); cold-start + TZ launchctl path already hardened in login.yml / wait_for_home_tab. Keep Android coverage.
_MM-T67856_1_2: Skip iOS: environmental cold-start flake, not a harness bug. Both flows PASSED on run 30424009936 (#9893, f86f99e) and FAILED on run 30447839548 (72c6f256c) with a functionally identical login.yml — same config, opposite outcomes. Failure is 'Assertion is false: id: tab_bar.home.tab is visible' during login's wait-for-home (~232-282s), i.e. the first cold Maestro batch on iOS, where almost everything else is already excluded. login.yml now retries with a 100s per-attempt home wait (~400s total budget vs the old single 180s), which improves the odds but cannot make a coin-flip deterministic. Keep Android coverage — both flows pass there (batch-5/batch-6, ~108-143s). Un-exclude once the iOS sim cold-start path is genuinely fixed rather than re-timed.
